articles.title: Forget Battles — Pokémon’s New Set Is a Masterclass in Tiny Art
articles.summary: Chaos Rising isn’t about who wins a card game. It’s about stunning micro-stories told through illustration rares: a meerkat lookout on a rooftop, a sheep in a flower meadow, a beach you can almost hear. The set drops May 22, and the art steals the show.

articles.title: Inkonbini Review: Finding Peace One Rice Ball at a Time
articles.summary: Inkonbini turns the monotony of a night-shift job at a Japanese convenience store into a meditative, heartwarming experience. You stock shelves, chat with lonely regulars, and discover that small acts of listening can change lives. Out now on Switch, PS5, Xbox, and PC.

articles.title: Radu Jude’s ‘Chambermaid’ Is a Messy, Meta, and Unexpectedly Moving Surprise
articles.summary: Romanian director Radu Jude loosely adapts a 19th-century novel into a modern story about a migrant maid in Paris. Through video calls and amateur theater, the film critiques class and colonialism, then lands a devastating emotional punch. Premiered at Cannes.
